items.expected_result: Original untagged/default/all_horizons requests, replay and output remain byte-compatible and validated.
Only four provenance-backed tag ids appear; query lane does not turn absent row category into source category.
Exact source query shape; reversed ordering, unexpected/duplicate fields and host/URL manipulations fail closed.
Finite 1-30 day horizon, lane rotation, bounded pages/requests, truthful truncation/unknown stop denominators.
Cross-lane membership/dedup/conflicts and zero-network replay reject modified raw hash, lane, time or offset.
Existing unsupported negRisk/stale/no-ask/fee-unknown semantics remain closed; no eligibility or edge admission.
Fake transport is sole product data input; negative fixture failures and physical request cap are observable.
Report fields, source confidence and versioned cold verification are complete without unauthorized promotion or raw echo.
